SUMMARY.md: Unofficial, undocumented JSON endpoints that the `www.apple.com` website itself loads (global navigation, store prices, newsroom feeds, careers and video-player strings). This is not an Apple-published API. Knowledge comes from the community Swift client https://github.com/l0v3m0n3y/apple (src/apple.swift lists the seven routes) and from live GET probes of every route on 2026-10-23. Unverified: which newsroom categories exist besides `photos` and `update` (`latest` and `press-release` returned an empty `results` list); which store `country` path values work besides `us` and `uk` (part numbers are store-specific, for example `MX2D3AM/A` in the US and `MX2D3ZM/A` in the UK); and locales other than en-US and fr-FR. The suggestions route needs its trailing slash (without it the server answers 200 with an empty body). No key is needed; Apple may change any of these without notice.
`PART` for a known part; `UNKNOWN` when the part number is not sold in this store (then only `id` and `type` are present).
